```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(htmltools)

source(here::here("R/legislature/06_weekly_activity.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
week_start <- as.Date(params$week_start)
week_end   <- week_start + 6

bill_actions <- load_bill_actions()
groups <- read_rds(here::here("data/legislature/bills/groups.rds"))
bills  <- read_csv(file.path(derived_csv_dir(), "bills.csv"),
                   col_select = c(bill_number, title), show_col_types = FALSE)

weeks <- weekly_activity_summary(bill_actions)   # newest first
this_week <- weeks |> filter(week_start == !!week_start)
stopifnot("No recorded actions in this week" = nrow(this_week) == 1)

# Neighbours among weeks that have a page (any action), skipping empty weeks
prev_week <- weeks |> filter(week_start < !!week_start) |> slice_max(week_start, n = 1) |> pull(week_start)
next_week <- weeks |> filter(week_start > !!week_start) |> slice_min(week_start, n = 1) |> pull(week_start)

is_latest <- week_start == max(weeks$week_start)
data_through <- max(bill_actions$date)

plural    <- \(n, word) paste(format(n, big.mark = ","), if (n == 1) word else paste0(word, "s"))
fmt_day   <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%b %e"))
fmt_long  <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%B %e, %Y"))
week_href <- \(d) paste0(format(d, "%Y-%m-%d"), ".html")
```

::: {.ia-breadcrumb}
[Legislation](../legislation/index.html) / [Weekly activity](index.html) / Week of `r fmt_day(week_start)`
:::

```{r}
nav_link <- function(d, arrow_first) {
  if (length(d) == 0) return(span(class = "ia-week-nav-off", if (arrow_first) "← Earlier" else "Later →"))
  a(href = week_href(d), if (arrow_first) paste("←", fmt_day(d)) else paste(fmt_day(d), "→"))
}

div(class = "ia-hero-row",
  div(
    div(class = "ia-eyebrow", "91st General Assembly"),
    h1(paste("Week of", fmt_long(week_start))),
    p(class = "ia-lead",
      sprintf("%s – %s · %s on %s",
              fmt_day(week_start), fmt_day(week_end),
              plural(this_week$n_actions, "action"),
              plural(this_week$n_groups_active, "bill group")),
      if (is_latest) span(class = "ia-week-through",
                          paste0(" · data through ", fmt_long(data_through))))
  ),
  div(class = "ia-week-nav", nav_link(prev_week, TRUE), nav_link(next_week, FALSE))
)
```

```{r}
# One tab for the whole week, then one per day with any recorded action
days <- sort(unique(bill_actions$date[bill_actions$date >= week_start & bill_actions$date <= week_end]))
periods <- c(
  list(list(id = "week", label = "Whole week", from = week_start, to = week_end, column = "This week")),
  lapply(days, \(d) list(id = format(d, "d%Y%m%d"), label = format(d, "%a %b %e") |> str_squish(),
                         from = d, to = d, column = "This day"))
)

period_cards <- function(from, to) {
  counts <- period_milestone_counts(bill_actions, from, to) |>
    filter(milestone != "vetoed" | n_groups > 0)
  do.call(ui_stat_grid, lapply(seq_len(nrow(counts)), \(i)
    ui_stat_card(counts$label[i], format(counts$n_groups[i], big.mark = ","))))
}

panes <- lapply(seq_along(periods), function(i) {
  p <- periods[[i]]
  rows <- period_group_rows(bill_actions, p$from, p$to, groups, bills)
  div(class = paste("tab-pane", if (i == 1) "active"), id = paste0("tab-", p$id),
      role = "tabpanel", `aria-labelledby` = paste0("tab-", p$id, "-btn"),
    period_cards(p$from, p$to),
    div(class = "ia-card",
      div(class = "ia-card-head",
        div(class = "ia-card-title", sprintf("%s with activity", plural(nrow(rows), "bill group"))),
        div(class = "ia-card-sub", style = "margin-bottom:0", "Expand a row for its actions")
      ),
      activity_table(rows, period_label = p$column)
    )
  )
})

tabs <- lapply(seq_along(periods), function(i) {
  p <- periods[[i]]
  tags$li(class = "nav-item", role = "presentation",
    tags$a(class = paste("nav-link", if (i == 1) "active"), id = paste0("tab-", p$id, "-btn"),
           href = paste0("#tab-", p$id), `data-bs-toggle` = "tab",
           `data-bs-target` = paste0("#tab-", p$id), role = "tab",
           `aria-controls` = paste0("tab-", p$id),
           `aria-selected` = if (i == 1) "true" else "false",
           p$label))
})

tagList(
  div(class = "panel-tabset ia-week-tabs",
    tags$ul(class = "nav nav-tabs", role = "tablist", tabs),
    div(class = "tab-content", panes)
  ),
  div(class = "ia-footnote",
    "Each number counts bill groups — a bill together with its companion bills and ",
    "the study bill it came from — that reached the stage during the period. A group ",
    "can count under more than one stage, and a week's numbers are not the sum of its ",
    "days. The table lists every group with any recorded action, procedural ones included.")
)
```
